ci.name: Bianchi IX bridge audit
ci.scope: Five tests; continuous Bianchi IX integration, Kasner/BKL transition checks, solver refinement, plot generation and artifact retention.

scope_note: The finite continuous two-bounce segment is not by itself a proof of chaos. The long sensitivity test uses the asymptotic BKL map. No stochastic force or same-Hamiltonian quantum Bianchi IX solver is included.
